panels.description: Gesamtzahl der eingegangenen Anrufe im Zeitraum

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT rg.cdr_id) AS total_calls
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

panels.title: Eingegangene Anrufe

panels.description: Anzahl der Anrufe, die erfolgreich angenommen wurden

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension'
      THEN rg.cdr_id
    END
  ) AS answered_calls
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr ON
  continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
  AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

panels.title: Angenommene Anrufe

panels.description: Prozentualer Anteil der Anrufe, die erfolgreich angenommen wurden

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension'
      THEN rg.cdr_id
    END
  ) * 100.0 /
  NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rg.cdr_id), 0)
  AS percent_answered
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr ON
  continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
  AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')

panels.description: Summe aller Gesprächszeiten im gewählten Zeitraum

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension'
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at, continued_in_cdr.cdr_ended_at)
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0) AS total_talking_time
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr
  ON continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
  AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
  AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
  AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

panels.title: Längste Anrufdauer
panels.description: Dauer des längsten Anrufs im gewählten Zeitraum

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN NOT (rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension')
      THEN rg.cdr_id
    END
  ) * 100.0 /
  NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rg.cdr_id), 0)
  AS missed_call_rate
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr ON
  continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
  AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

SELECT
  coalesce(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, rg.cdr_started_at, rg.cdr_ended_at)), 0) AS duration
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
;

SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension'
        THEN COALESCE(continued_in_cdr.termination_reason, 'other')
      ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT('not_answered__', rg.termination_reason), 'other')
    END
    AS call_outcome,
    COUNT(*) AS call_count
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr ON
  continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
  AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
GROUP BY call_outcome
ORDER BY call_count DESC
;

panels.title: Eingegangene / Angenommene Anrufe (Verlauf)

targets.rawSql:
-- Ring group info with last name
WITH rg_info AS (
  SELECT
    rg.destination_dn_number AS dn_number,
    CASE WHEN '${ring_group:value}' = 'All' THEN 'All ring groups' ELSE COALESCE(rg.destination_dn_name, 'Unknown') END AS name
  FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
  WHERE rg.cdr_started_at = ( -- Changed this line
    SELECT
      MAX(sub_rg.cdr_started_at) -- Changed this to MAX(cdr_started_at)
    FROM public_cdroutput AS sub_rg
    WHERE $__timeFilter(sub_rg.cdr_started_at)
      AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR sub_rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
      AND sub_rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
  )
),
-- Ring group totals
rg_totals AS (
  SELECT
    0 AS row_order_no,
    MAX(rg.destination_dn_number) AS rg_dn,
    MAX(rg_info.name) AS rg_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rg.cdr_id) AS rg_received_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_id IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL AND continued_in_cdr.destination_entity_type = 'extension'
        THEN rg.cdr_id
      END
    ) AS rg_answered_count
  FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
  INNER JOIN rg_info ON TRUE 
  LEFT JOIN public_cdroutput AS continued_in_cdr ON
    continued_in_cdr.cdr_id = rg.continued_in_cdr_id
    AND continued_in_cdr.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
    AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
    AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
  GROUP BY rg.destination_dn_number -- Added GROUP BY for rg_totals
),
-- Ring group users statistics
rg_users_stat AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS row_order_no,
    MAX(rg.destination_dn_number) AS rg_dn,
    MAX(rg_info.name) AS rg_name,
    agent_polls.destination_dn_number AS agent_dn,
    COALESCE(agent_polls.destination_dn_name, 'Unknown') AS agent_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND agent_polls.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN rg.cdr_id END) AS agent_answered_polls_count,
    COUNT(agent_polls.cdr_id) AS agent_received_polls_count
  FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
  INNER JOIN rg_info ON TRUE -- This will cause issues if rg_info returns multiple rows. See note below.
  INNER JOIN public_cdroutput AS agent_polls ON
    agent_polls.call_history_id = rg.call_history_id
    AND agent_polls.originating_cdr_id = rg.cdr_id
    AND agent_polls.destination_dn_type = 'extension'
    AND agent_polls.creation_method = 'route_to'
    AND agent_polls.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
    AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
    AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
  GROUP BY agent_polls.destination_dn_number, agent_polls.destination_dn_name, rg.destination_dn_number -- Added rg.destination_dn_number to GROUP BY
)
SELECT
  rg.row_order_no,
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN '${ring_group:value}' != 'All' THEN CONCAT(rg.rg_dn, ' ') ELSE '' END, rg.rg_name, ' [totals]') AS extension,
  COALESCE(rg.rg_received_count, 0) AS calls_received,
  COALESCE(rg.rg_received_count, 0) - COALESCE(rg.rg_answered_count, 0) AS calls_unanswered,
  COALESCE(rg.rg_answered_count, 0) AS calls_answered,
  CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED INTEGER) AS polls_received,
  CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED INTEGER) AS polls_missed
FROM rg_totals AS rg
UNION ALL
SELECT
  u.row_order_no,
  CONCAT(u.agent_dn, ' ', u.agent_name) AS extension,
  CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED INTEGER) AS calls_received,
  CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED INTEGER) AS calls_unanswered,
  COALESCE(u.agent_answered_polls_count, 0) AS calls_answered,
  COALESCE(u.agent_received_polls_count, 0) AS polls_received,
  COALESCE(u.agent_received_polls_count, 0) - COALESCE(u.agent_answered_polls_count, 0) AS polls_missed
FROM rg_users_stat AS u
ORDER BY row_order_no, extension;

SELECT
    STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(rg.cdr_started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rg.cdr_id) AS num_calls
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
;

panels.description: This shows the number of answered calls per extension in the ring group.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(agent_polls.destination_dn_number, ' ', COALESCE(agent_polls.destination_dn_name, 'Unknown')) AS agent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT agent_polls.main_call_history_id) AS agent_received_calls_count,
  COUNT(agent_polls.cdr_id) AS agent_received_polls_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rg.termination_reason IN ('continued_in', 'redirected') AND rg.termination_reason_details = 'polling' AND agent_polls.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN rg.cdr_id END) AS agent_answered_polls_count
FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
INNER JOIN public_cdroutput AS agent_polls ON
  agent_polls.call_history_id = rg.call_history_id
  AND agent_polls.originating_cdr_id = rg.cdr_id
  AND agent_polls.destination_dn_type = 'extension'
  AND agent_polls.creation_method = 'route_to'
  AND agent_polls.creation_forward_reason = 'polling'
WHERE $__timeFilter(rg.cdr_started_at)
  AND ('${ring_group:value}' = 'All' OR rg.destination_dn_number = '${ring_group:value}')
  AND rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
GROUP BY agent
ORDER BY agent
;

panels.title: Anrufstatistik nach Rufgruppenmitgliedern

list.definition:
WITH rg AS (
  SELECT
    rg.destination_dn_number AS dn_number,
    COALESCE(rg.destination_dn_name, 'Unknown') AS name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rg.destination_dn_number ORDER BY rg.cdr_started_at DESC) AS row_num
  FROM public_cdroutput AS rg
  WHERE rg.destination_dn_type IN ('ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt')
    AND rg.destination_dn_number IS NOT NULL
    AND rg.cdr_started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 365 DAY
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(rg.dn_number, ' ', rg.name) AS __text,
  rg.dn_number AS __value
FROM rg
WHERE rg.row_num = 1
ORDER BY __value;
